unitemized.reason: The concrete spec path is fixed by the artifact path pattern (specs/{CAP}/spec.md), and the spec artifact_exists item (ff-041) already checks that a concrete file was written there. A path_match regex would need literals that do not appear in the cited line.
In the spec-driven schema the required set covers every artifact (proposal, specs, design, tasks), so nothing falls outside it and there is nothing observable to check.
Already covered: the artifact_exists items for the required set (ff-039/ff-041) and the openspec status re-run check (ff-040).
Permissive (MAY): skipping a conditional artifact is allowed, not required. The effect on design is captured by downgrading design's artifact_exists to should.
Covered by the must-level spec artifact_exists item under ff-041. The only allowed exception (skipped status) cannot be observed by the engine.
Applies only when the agent decides to skip a conditional artifact, and the notice goes to the user's chat output. Neither the condition nor the message can be expressed in the reference language.
Covered by the artifact_exists items for tasks/spec/proposal. The 'blocked only because of a skipped dependency' condition cannot be observed.
This is a loop-termination rule with no artifact or trace event of its own. Its outcome (all required artifacts exist) is covered by the artifact_exists items.
